searchProfile: 2026-09-06 connected GovTribe refresh. Federal discovery searched active future-due Solicitation and Pre-Solicitation records in the 27 east-of-Mississippi target states for NAICS 236220/237110/237310/237990; ambiguous Massachusetts, Michigan, Mississippi, and Vermont place identifiers were resolved with GovTribe-compatible location identifiers, yielding 115 target-state matches. A 340-record national NAICS search was retained only as a supplemental cross-check; SAM.gov remains authoritative. SLED discovery used four construction-focused keyword groups: building/renovation/construction/design-build/CMAR (18 hits), water/sewer/wastewater/pump/lift station/pipeline/stormwater (9 hits), road/paving/bridge/culvert (115 hits), and demolition/sitework (40 hits), totaling 182 raw search hits before cross-query deduplication. The continuity merge preserves still-active vetted GovTribe SLED pursuits and adds qualified current records with direct public procurement links. Consulting-only, inspection/testing-only, staffing, goods-only, maintenance-only/on-call, prequalification-only, sale/property, printing, and obvious non-construction noise are excluded. IDIQ/MACC/SATOC ceilings and contract capacities are never used as project ROMs.
